plan.explanation: Face F1 is machined first to establish the datum. Through holes F2 and F5 are drilled (spot drill + drilling). Pocket F3 is milled. Reamed hole F4 follows the sequence: spot drill, drill, then ream, respecting the precedence that drilling precedes reaming on F4.
assumptions: All operations are performed on Machine M1 to simplify setup and avoid collision modeling.
uncertainties: Tool access for pocket milling into features F3 and F5 is not verified against specific geometry constraints.
